name: Term Loan Scheme
description: Financial assistance for setting up small businesses, service enterprises, and self-employment ventures for individuals belonging to Scheduled Caste communities.
overview: The Term Loan Scheme by NSFDC provides concessional finance to members of Scheduled Castes living below the double poverty line for undertaking income-generating activities. The scheme aims to uplift the target group by providing them with financial assistance to start or expand their own businesses.

financials.subsidyDetails: Up to 50% subsidy on interest for women and persons with disabilities

benefits: Low interest rate of 6% per annum
Flexible repayment tenure up to 10 years
Additional interest subsidy for women beneficiaries
No collateral required up to ₹5 Lakh
applicationProcess: Visit nearest Channel Partner (SCA/MFI/NGO)
Fill the application form with required documents
Submit project report for business viability assessment
Application forwarded to NSFDC by Channel Partner
Loan sanctioned after verification and approval
Amount disbursed through Channel Partner

name: Micro Credit Finance
description: Small loans for micro-enterprises and livelihood activities for individuals from Scheduled Caste communities with annual family income below the poverty line.
overview: Micro Credit Finance scheme provides small loans to SC beneficiaries for undertaking income-generating micro-enterprise activities. This scheme is designed for those who need small amounts of capital to start petty businesses, street vending, or other small-scale economic activities.
benefits: Very low interest rate of 5% per annum
applicationProcess: Approach nearest Channel Partner or Self-Help Group
Submit basic application with identity and income proof
Brief activity description reviewed by Channel Partner
Loan sanctioned within 15-30 days
Amount disbursed directly to beneficiary account

name: Mahila Samridhi Yojana
description: Dedicated scheme for women entrepreneurs from Scheduled Caste communities to establish or expand micro-enterprises with concessional financing.
overview: Mahila Samridhi Yojana is a special scheme exclusively for SC women to encourage entrepreneurship and self-reliance. The scheme offers highly concessional terms including reduced interest rates and higher subsidy components to empower women economically.

financials.subsidyDetails: Additional 2% interest subsidy for timely repayment

benefits: Lowest interest rate at 4% per annum
Additional interest rebate for timely repayment
applicationProcess: Contact nearest Women Self-Help Group or Channel Partner
Fill application form with required documents
Activity/project description reviewed
Loan sanctioned after verification
Disbursement through Channel Partner to bank account
Optional skill training provided before disbursement

name: Education Loan Scheme
description: Educational loans for students from Scheduled Caste families to pursue professional and technical courses at recognized institutions in India and abroad.
overview: The Education Loan Scheme enables SC students to pursue higher education including professional courses, technical education, and studies abroad. The scheme covers tuition fees, hostel charges, book expenses, and other course-related costs.

financials.subsidyDetails: Full interest subsidy during course period for family income below ₹2 Lakh

documents: Mark Sheets of Last Qualifying Exam
benefits: Low interest rate of 4% per annum
Covers tuition, hostel, books, and equipment
Interest subsidy during study period for BPL families
Covers both India and abroad studies
No collateral for loans up to ₹7.5 Lakh
applicationProcess: Secure admission in a recognized institution
Apply through nearest Channel Partner with admission letter
Submit income proof and academic records
Loan sanctioned based on course and institution
Fee paid directly to institution
Repayment begins after moratorium period

name: Green Business Loan
description: Special financing for eco-friendly and sustainable business ventures by entrepreneurs from backward classes including solar energy, organic farming, and waste management.
overview: Green Business Loan promotes environmentally sustainable enterprises among backward class entrepreneurs. The scheme supports solar energy projects, organic farming, waste recycling, eco-tourism, and other green business initiatives with preferential financing terms.

financials.subsidyDetails: Additional 25% capital subsidy for solar and renewable energy projects

benefits: Capital subsidy for renewable energy projects
Technical support for green project planning
Priority processing for solar and organic farming
applicationProcess: Prepare green business project report
Apply through Channel Partner with documents
Environmental feasibility assessed
Loan sanctioned after technical evaluation
Disbursement in phases linked to project milestones
Regular monitoring and technical guidance provided
